npm lockfile for apps/mobile. Integrity hashes are base64 and resolved versions are long digit runs, which is what the scanner sees. PR #19 replaced the name-based lockfile exemption with an exact path plus digest precisely so a file cannot claim this by being called package-lock.json; regenerating it needs a new review. Repinned in PR #50 after adding expo-camera, expo-file-system, expo-image-manipulator and expo-image-picker for the bill camera; the four findings the guard raised were integrity hashes and npm version strings in the added entries, no participant data. `npm install --package-lock-only` reproduces these exact bytes.
